choices.reason: Ethyl acetoacetate at 20/1 measured 24.23/64.37 mL versus a premeasurement prediction of 14.95/30.53; 10/1 tests the extent of this error along the solvent-ratio curve.
The 1/1 methoxyethyl acetoacetate condition probes whether the beta-keto ester error extends to a related ester at a lower ratio.
The multifunctional acetoacetate ester at 1/1 tests transfer of the beta-keto ester response to a larger molecule.
Acetoxybenzaldehyde measured 43.63/75.43 mL at 10/1, far above its premeasurement prediction; 5/1 tests the condition slope.
Measured trifluoromethoxyphenol rows show ratio-dependent errors; 50/1 extends that curve.
Nitrobenzophenone has an irregular observed V2 pattern across measured ratios; 1/1 adds a lower-ratio anchor.
Methylquinoline at 10/1 tests whether the previously observed quinoline error transfers to a close analogue.
Acetophenone oxime measured 43.11/119.20 mL at 50/1; 20/1 constrains its intermediate-ratio response.
Ortho-fluorobenzonitrile measured 20.19/43.54 mL at 50/1, above its premeasurement prediction; 10/1 tests the ratio dependence of that error.
Ortho-tolunitrile at 10/1 provides a substituent contrast for the ortho-fluorobenzonitrile probe.
Salicylaldehyde has measured 0/1 and 50/1 endpoints; 20/1 tests its interior response curve.
Ortho-isopropylphenol at 50/1 tests whether high-ratio behavior transfers across phenols with different second substituents.
Fluorenone extends the aromatic-ketone observations to a fused, constrained scaffold.
Bromobenzofuran provides a fused heteroaromatic contrast with little direct measured feedback.
Measured 50/1 fluorobenzoate and iodobenzoate rows were overpredicted; this substituted benzoate tests transfer of that error.
Dibenzyl ether adds an aromatic ether contrast to the ester and ketone selections.

hypotheses.content: Beta-keto ester prediction error depends on solvent ratio and may transfer across ester substituents.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does ethyl acetoacetate remain underpredicted at 10/1, and does the related ester show a similar curve?

hypotheses.content: The large acetoxybenzaldehyde error at 10/1 may reflect a mislearned solvent-ratio response.
Trifluoromethoxyphenol prediction error changes with PE/EA ratio.
Nitrobenzophenone V2 may depart from the model's smooth solvent-ratio trend.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Does the 1/1 measurement clarify the lower end of its V2 curve?

hypotheses.content: The quinoline retention error may transfer to methylquinoline.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Is methylquinoline at 10/1 underpredicted despite the accurate 2-phenylpyridine measurement?

hypotheses.content: Acetophenone oxime's high V2 at 50/1 may persist at intermediate ratios.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: What are its V1 and V2 at 20/1?

hypotheses.content: Ortho-substituted benzonitrile error may depend on both solvent ratio and substituent identity.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: How do the fluoro and methyl analogues compare at 10/1?

hypotheses.content: Phenolic response curves may share a high-ratio pattern across different second substituents.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Do salicylaldehyde at 20/1 and isopropylphenol at 50/1 follow the patterns suggested by the measured phenols?

hypotheses.content: Fused aromatic scaffolds may expose transfer errors not characterized by measured open-chain aromatic compounds.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Are fluorenone and bromobenzofuran prediction errors similar to those of measured aromatic analogues?

hypotheses.content: High-ratio benzoate overprediction may transfer to another substituted benzoate but not to an aromatic ether.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Is the substituted benzoate overpredicted at 50/1, and does dibenzyl ether show the same bias?

result.feedback_interpretation: The acquired measurements show large premeasurement errors for ethyl acetoacetate at 20/1 and acetoxybenzaldehyde at 10/1, plus ratio-dependent errors in several phenolic and aromatic compounds. These choices test nearby conditions and chemical transfer. Round-4 CW entries remain unmeasured and provide no observed evidence. V2−V1 is an elution interval width, not prediction uncertainty.
